limitations: One 8xH200 host, Qwen3-235B BF16, two TP4 replicas, one frozen LooGLE trace, 1.4 offered RPS, two repetitions per policy; this is not a paper-wide performance reproduction.
ABBA reduces ordering bias; there are only two trial repetitions per policy, and requests sharing prefixes are not independent experimental replicates.
Percentiles use all raw observations within each policy; trial p95 values are never averaged. Throughput uses summed measured replay duration and excludes startup/warmup.
Backend cached_tokens measures realized local cache reuse, not accuracy of the frontend virtual cache. No cross-worker KV transfer, Mooncake, or physical cache synchronization is enabled.
Modern SGLang GPU execution, chunk construction, memory allocation, and preserving generated tokens on retraction remain version adaptations; CPU source checks do not validate GPU timing.

Global differential evidence comprises 9012 select calls AND 9012 finish attempts: 9006 successful finishes and 6 assertion failures shared with the pinned original. Reference-state parity does not mean every replay operation succeeded.
Original candidate-subset indexing, overlapping-prefix histogram assertions, and duplicate-parent virtual eviction accounting remain visible reference behaviors.
Output hashes are alignment diagnostics. Temperature zero does not guarantee identical text across different batch shapes; hash agreement is not a quality or performance validity requirement.
Requested max_new_tokens=45 is clamped to44 for32722-token prompts by the frozen context/allocation bounds. Length finishes must equal the effective cap; shorter stop finishes are allowed.
CPU MPQ41, FIFO8, public HTTP TPOT3, and cancellation41 checks are separate functional evidence. Only the1572 real requests in this bundle are GPU inference evidence.
